external_entities.name: sensor node
external_entities.description: A deployed sensor node installed at a customer site that publishes readings, polls for firmware, and is serviced locally.
external_entities.source_excerpt: a few thousand sensor nodes installed on customer sites
external_entities.notes: Nodes use a fleet-wide pre-shared key. The source says the key has not been rotated since deployment.

external_entities.name: field technician
external_entities.description: A technician who services sensor nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.notes: The source does not state what authentication the serial console has, if any.

external_entities.name: fleet operator
external_entities.description: An operator who views telemetry dashboards from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network

processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: An MQTT broker that accepts sensor readings, checks devices in the registry, and forwards accepted readings to Pub/Sub.
processes.source_excerpt: the device gateway, which is an MQTT broker we run on GKE
processes.notes: The gateway is exposed to the internet. Nodes authenticate to it with a fleet-wide pre-shared key.

processes.name: telemetry normalizer
processes.description: A Python consumer that picks up readings from Pub/Sub and writes them into the telemetry lake.
processes.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

data_stores.name: device registry
data_stores.description: A Firestore registry used by the gateway to check a device key and determine which customer a node belongs to.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to

data_stores.name: Pub/Sub
data_stores.description: A messaging service receiving accepted readings for consumption by the telemetry normalizer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_stores.name: telemetry lake
data_stores.description: A BigQuery data store containing sensor telemetry, site addresses, and occupancy patterns.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it, so it is customer data.

data_stores.name: Cloud Storage bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket from which sensor nodes poll for firmware images.
data_stores.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_stores.notes: The bucket is public read. The source does not state whether nodes check a signature before installing an image.

data_flows.name: publish readings
data_flows.description: A sensor node publishes readings to the device gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway

data_flows.name: look up device
data_flows.description: The device gateway looks up a device in the device registry to check its key and identify its customer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to.

data_flows.name: forward readings
data_flows.description: The gateway forwards accepted readings onto Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_flows.name: pick up readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer picks up readings from Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: picked up by the telemetry normalizer

data_flows.name: write readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer writes readings into the telemetry lake.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which writes them into the telemetry lake in BigQuery

data_flows.name: poll image
data_flows.description: A sensor node polls the Cloud Storage bucket for a firmware image.
data_flows.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image

data_flows.name: service node
data_flows.description: A field technician services a sensor node over a local serial console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
data_flows.notes: The source says: "I don't know what authentication that console has, if any."

data_flows.name: view dashboards
data_flows.description: A fleet operator looks at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network, signed in with company SSO.

trust_boundaries.name: customer site
trust_boundaries.description: A customer-controlled site where sensor nodes are installed and serviced.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: sensor nodes installed on customer sites

trust_boundaries.name: analytics network
trust_boundaries.description: The network in which the telemetry normalizer runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which fleet operators view dashboards.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network

assumptions.assumption: The device gateway presents a non-web interface because it is described as an MQTT broker.
assumptions.basis: The source describes the device gateway as an MQTT broker.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry normalizer presents a non-web interface because it is described as a Python consumer.
assumptions.basis: The source describes it as a Python consumer rather than a web application.

assumptions.assumption: The device registry contains confidential data because it stores a device key and customer association.
assumptions.basis: The source says the registry is used to check the key and find which customer the node belongs to.

assumptions.assumption: Pub/Sub contains confidential data because it carries accepted sensor readings.
assumptions.basis: The source says accepted readings are forwarded onto Pub/Sub, and the telemetry is customer data.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake is confidential because it contains site addresses and occupancy patterns identified as customer data.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns and is customer data.

assumptions.assumption: The Cloud Storage bucket is public because the source states that it is public read.
assumptions.basis: The source says the bucket is public read.
